1: Main Allah ke naam se shuru karta hoon, jo Ar-Rehman hai — bahut meherbaan — aur Ar-Raheem hai — nihayat reham karne wala. Allah ke yeh dono naam Arabi lafz 'rehmat' se nikle hain, jis ka matlab hai meherbani: yeh us ki rehmat ki azmat aur wusat ko sabit karte hain, aur yeh ke us ki rehmat har cheez ko ghere hue hai aur tamam jaandaron ko apne daman mein liye hue hai. Har niyamat usi ki rehmat se hai, aur sab se bari rehmat mominon ko milti hai.
2: Tamam tareef Allah hi ke liye hai — us ki zaat ke sath, us ki sifaat ke sath aur us ke kaamon ke sath — kyunke wohi har cheez ka paida karne wala hai. Har cheez usi ki hai aur wohi un ke tamam maamlaat ka intezam karne wala hai; woh khaas logon ko bhi niyamat deta hai aur aam insanon ko bhi.
3: Allah ke do naam, Ar-Rehman aur Ar-Raheem, lafz 'rehmat' se nikle hain: yeh makhluq ke liye us ki meherbani ko zahir karte hain, aur mominon ko is rehmat ka sab se bara hissa milta hai.
4: Wohi qayamat ke din ka maalik hai — woh din jis mein humein dobara zinda kiya jayega aur jo kuch humne kiya us ka badla diya jayega. Us din us ki tamam makhluq apne aamaal ka hisaab degi aur un ka badla payegi. Us din Allah poochega: “Aaj baadshahi kis ki hai?” [Surah Ghafir: 16] Koi bhi, chahe us ka martaba kitna hi buland ho, jawab nahin dega; phir Allah khud hi farmayega: “Allah hi ki, jo Akela hai, sab par ghalib hai.” [Surah Ghafir: 16]
5: Hum tere siwa kisi ki ibadat nahin karte aur kisi ki itaat nahin karte; hum tere sath kisi ko shareek nahin thehrate, aur apne tamam maamlaat mein sirf tujh hi se madad maangte hain. Har bhalai tere hi hath mein hai, aur tere siwa koi madadgar nahin.
6: Humein seedha raasta dikha aur us par chalna aasan kar de — woh raasta jo teri farmanbardari ka hai aur jis mein koi kaji nahin — aur humein us par qaayam rakh —
7: Usi raaste par jis par tu ne apne un bandon ko chalaya jinhein tu ne hidayat ki niyamat di — jaise Nabiyon, sachchon, shaheedon aur neik logon ko. Yeh log kaise achhe saathi hain! Aur humein un logon ke raaste se bacha jin par tera gazab hua, jo haqq ko jaan kar bhi us ki pairwi nahin karte — jaise Bani Israel ka haal tha; aur humein un logon ke raaste se bhi bacha jo bhatak gaye aur hidayat na pa sake, kyunke woh haqq ko talash karne aur us ki rehnumai lene mein ghaflat karte rahe — jaise Nasara ka haal tha.
